query: What legal authority does the Economic Offences Wing have in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Economic Offences Wing Jurisdiction:
The Economic Offences Wing in Tamil Nadu has jurisdiction over cases related to economic crimes, such as cheating, forgery, and financial frauds, that exceed ₹1 crore.
answer: The Economic Offences Wing (EOW) in Tamil Nadu operates under the authority of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID). It has specialized powers to investigate economic crimes. [Document 1]
